nodes.name: creator-workflow.ts
nodes.summary: Server actions powering the creator workflow: goal selection, viral video discovery, content suggestion, viral prediction, and workflow retrieval, with audit IDs and Supabase persistence.

nodes.name: actSelectGoal
nodes.summary: Server action that records the user's selected creator goal and initializes a new workflow row in Supabase.

nodes.name: actDiscoverViralVideos
nodes.summary: Server action that queries viral video candidates for a workflow's niche and goal, persisting the discovery batch for downstream steps.

nodes.name: actSuggestContent
nodes.summary: Server action that produces AI-generated content suggestions for the workflow based on the discovered viral examples and user niche.

nodes.name: actPredictViral
nodes.summary: Server action that invokes the prediction pipeline on a generated script and stores the predicted viral score against the workflow.

nodes.name: getWorkflow
nodes.summary: Reads a creator workflow row by ID from Supabase and returns the hydrated record.

nodes.name: validation-workflow.ts
nodes.summary: Server actions implementing the prediction validation lifecycle: run creation, cohort building, pattern extraction, fingerprint generation, prediction locking, accuracy validation, and run retrieval with event emission.

nodes.name: emitEvent
nodes.summary: Internal helper that records validation workflow events to the platform_events table for auditing.

nodes.name: actCreateValidationRun
nodes.summary: Server action that creates a new validation run row and seeds tracking events for the prediction-accuracy workflow.

nodes.name: actBuildCohort
nodes.summary: Server action that selects and persists the cohort of videos for a validation run based on the provided filter criteria.

nodes.name: actExtractPatterns
nodes.summary: Server action that extracts statistical patterns from the cohort and stores them for use in fingerprint generation.

nodes.name: actGenerateFingerprints
nodes.summary: Server action that synthesizes per-video fingerprints from extracted patterns and persists them on the validation run.

nodes.name: actLockPredictions
nodes.summary: Server action that locks the generated predictions for the run to prevent further edits and records a hash for tamper detection.

nodes.name: actValidateAccuracy
nodes.summary: Server action that compares locked predictions against observed outcomes and writes accuracy metrics back to the run.

nodes.name: actUpdateRun
nodes.summary: Server action that updates mutable fields on a validation run row and emits an audit event.

nodes.name: actApproveRun
nodes.summary: Server action that marks a validation run as approved by an authorized reviewer and emits the approval event.

nodes.name: actGetRun
nodes.summary: Server action that retrieves a single validation run by ID, including its associated metadata.

nodes.name: actGetPreviousRuns
nodes.summary: Server action that returns the most recent validation runs up to the supplied limit for dashboard listing.
